title: Café de Olla (Mexican Spiced Coffee) - Muy Bueno
ldKeywords: cafe de olla recipe, homemade cafe de olla, Mexican coffee recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 6 to 8 ounces piloncillo (or substitute packed brown sugar)
6 tablespoons freshly ground dark roasted coffee
ldInstructionsRaw: In a medium saucepan bring the water to a boil. Carefully add piloncillo, cinnamon sticks, cloves, and anise star.
Stir with a wooden spoon until the piloncillo dissolves, about 5 minutes. Add the ground coffee and stir, turn off heat, cover, and let steep for an additional 5 minutes.
Strain the coffee through cheesecloth and enjoy.
